name: Dearborn Heights
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Dearborn Heights, MI 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Dearborn Heights, MI: Winterfest at City Hall with Santa and fireworks, the library Holiday Open House and Winter Wonderland.
lede: Dearborn Heights does Christmas at City Hall and the library, with a two day Winterfest, a tree village open house and an indoor winter wonderland.
celebrates: The City of Dearborn Heights holds Winterfest at City Hall, 6045 Fenton Street, on Friday and Saturday, December 4 and 5, 2026, from 3 to 7 pm. The city lists local vendors, holiday music, youth performances, movies, crafts, ice carving, games, hot cocoa, a holiday zipline and a chance to meet Santa, with a Tree Lighting Ceremony and Fireworks Show on Saturday at 7 pm. The Dearborn Heights Library follows on December 12 with a Holiday Open House and a Holiday Tree Village at the John F. Kennedy, Jr. Library.
lastyear: The city's calendar still carries its 2024 Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony, held Tuesday, December 3, 2024, from 6:30 to 8:30 pm at City Hall and billed as a free family event with Santa cookie decorating. That shows the City Hall tree lighting is a repeat tradition, now stretched into the two day Winterfest. We did not find a host recap of 2025, so this page relies on the 2026 listings.
facts: The library's Holiday Open House includes a Holiday Tree Village where visitors vote for a favorite tree, and the library invited 10 to 20 families or businesses to adopt a tree to decorate. The city's Winterfest announcement lists a holiday zipline, ice carving and a fireworks show. Winter Wonderland at Hype Athletics, 23302 West Warren Avenue, is also listed for Sunday, December 20 from 11 am to 4 pm.
trains: Dearborn Heights does not list a Christmas train ride of its own. Next door in Dearborn, The Henry Ford's Greenfield Village has a heritage railroad with an 1884 roundhouse, and The Henry Ford's Giant Screen Experience shows The Polar Express in 3D daily through January 1. The Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens is a volunteer-run museum in an 1859 Grand Trunk depot. Check each page for current dates.

faq: When is Winterfest in Dearborn Heights?
Friday and Saturday, December 4 and 5, 2026, from 3 to 7 pm at City Hall, 6045 Fenton Street. The tree lighting and fireworks are Saturday at 7 pm.
Can kids meet Santa at Winterfest?
The city's announcement lists a chance to meet Santa among the activities, along with crafts, games, movies, ice carving and hot cocoa.
What is the Dearborn Heights Library Holiday Open House?

An annual event on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from noon to 4 pm at the John F. Kennedy, Jr. Library, with a Holiday Tree Village, hot chocolate and cookies, a craft, music, local vendors and a raffle.
Is there a tree lighting in Dearborn Heights?
Yes. The Tree Lighting Ceremony and Fireworks Show are Saturday, December 5, 2026 at 7 pm during Winterfest.
The city's announcement does not print a price, so call (313) 971-3980 to confirm.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dearborn Heights for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events. The magic runs from December 4 (Winterfest at City Hall) through December 20 (Winter Wonderland at Hype Athletics), with the Winterfest tree lighting and fireworks on December 5 and the library Holiday Open House on December 12 along the way. The city and library pages do not print prices, so call ahead. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
